description: This Java class is a Spring MVC controller for managing 'Curso' (course) entities, including CRUD operations and course detail viewing, with role-based access control.

classes.name: CursoController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for handling course-related web requests, including adding, editing, deleting, and viewing course details with role-based security.

methods.name: addCurso
methods.description: Handles GET request to show form for adding a new course for a specific professor.

methods.name: saveCurso
methods.description: Handles POST request to save a new course for a specific professor.

methods.name: getCursoForUpdate
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve course data for editing.

methods.name: updateCurso
methods.description: Handles POST request to update an existing course.

methods.name: getCursosList
methods.description: Handles GET request to list all courses.

methods.name: deleteCurso
methods.description: Handles GET request to delete a course.

methods.name: getCursoDetail
methods.description: Handles GET request to view course details, including enrollment status.
